title: SGLang-Omni serving recipes and streaming audio measurements
summary: Resolve the model-specific config and endpoint, then compare first audio, chunk gaps, duration/RTF, errors and quality under controlled load.

zh-CN.title: SGLang-Omni 服务配方与流式音频测量
zh-CN.summary: 解析模型专属配置和端点，在受控负载下比较首音频、分块间隔、时长/RTF、错误与质量。

conditions: Choose a supported model recipe, endpoint, reference audio and matching checkpoint/config class.
Retain platform dependencies, resolved config/diff/provenance and per-process memory budgets.

recommendations: Resolve/explain with the proposed launch arguments, establish readiness and one complete audio/text result, then measure concurrency.
Investigate the saturated admission/request-build/AR queue; distinguish weights, KV, graphs, vocoder and communication allocations for OOMs.
validation_plan: Check output modality, sample rate, SSE errors, EOS and complete content; HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
Repeat warm baseline/candidate trials on the same dataset and sampling with audio quality, latency distributions, duration/RTF and failures.
limitations: Config resolution can import optional model dependencies or require cached/network metadata; it is not a dependency-free smoke test.
Chunking and asynchronous decode options are model-specific, with no universal latency gain.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
